title: Linear extension by zero
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $j\colon U\to X$ an open immersion.
With $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ ([sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]) and module
objects as in [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], the *linear extension by zero*

$$
j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\colon\Mod_{j^*\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_X}
$$

is the linearization ([sk-def-sfb-transport]) of the extension by zero $j^{\Ab}_!$ of
abelian sheaves through the projection formula of [lem-sfb-open-projection-formula]:
it sends a $j^*\Lambda_X$-module $M$ to $j^{\Ab}_!M$ with the $\Lambda_X$-action

$$
\Lambda_X\otimes j^{\Ab}_!M\cong j^{\Ab}_!(j^*\Lambda_X\otimes M)
\xrightarrow{\;j^{\Ab}_!(\text{action})\;}j^{\Ab}_!M .
$$

Its underlying sheaf functor is $j^{\Ab}_!$, it is exact, and it is left adjoint to
the transport $\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_X}\to
\Mod_{j^*\Lambda_X}$.

proof.text:
The pullback $j^*_{\Ab}$ is strong monoidal and the projection formula holds
([lem-sfb-open-projection-formula]), so the linearization of
[sk-def-sfb-transport] applies to $P=j^{\Ab}_!$ and $S=j^*_{\Ab}$: it produces the
module structure displayed above (associativity and unitality of the action follow
from the coherence of the projection isomorphism), and it lifts the adjunction
$j^{\Ab}_!\dashv j^*_{\Ab}$ to $j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\dashv
\operatorname{mapMod}(j^*_{\Ab})$. The extension by zero $j^{\Ab}_!$ is exact
([sk-def-sfb-finite-lower-shriek]), and finite limits and colimits of module objects
are computed on underlying sheaves ([sk-prop-sfb-module-category]), so
$j^{\mathrm{lin}}_!$ is exact.
